upgradeScheduledCollection.note: Three sites assumes Peterborough, Wittering and one gauge. Forecast calls include one latest UKV product per site. Unsupported runs/diagnostics can add requests; persistent budget guards defer them. Existing browser scenarios below model sparse historical backfill only, not all metadata/latest-product checks. This is a plan, not observed traffic.

scenarios.name: 24-hour cold start; deterministic publication lag 0h
scenarios.assumptions: One visible browser installation, hourly core check for 24h, Night Sky visible for 12h, all supported variables, 4 distinct ensemble cycles; no transient retries. Plans are simulated with the real getRunTasks and endpoint cost function, not provider traffic measurements.

retryCost: Every retry/fallback is separately metered. A 429 can pause all requests; no retry bypasses the daily/minute guard.
caveat: A request plan is not a claim about worst-case publication failures or shared-IP traffic. Repeated optional-variable rejection, extra refreshes and other devices can increase provider usage. Hard local limits stop the plan from running indefinitely.
